name: go-libp2p-kad-dht-drainable-routing-lifecycles
instr:
go-libp2p-kad-dht cannot reversibly stop new local routing work while admitted work finishes. Add draining to root `IpfsDHT`, `fullrt.FullRT`, and `dual.DHT`. Expose `DrainState`, `DrainReport`, `ErrDraining`, `IpfsDHT.Drain`, and `New` from `github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p-kad-dht`; `FullRT.Drain` and `NewFullRT` from its `fullrt` package; and `DHT.Drain` and `New` from its `dual` package.

Each drain must atomically fence admission, reject later local operations with `ErrDraining`, and wait for all admitted synchronous, streaming, bulk, query, follow-up, merge, and deduplication work to become caller-visible. Ownership continues until every producer or worker terminates normally, by cancellation, or by failure, including after asynchronous returns, without changing reported failures. Reports must accurately count completed work.

Exclude FullRT's autonomous crawler. Drain dual as one transaction across its parent and WAN and LAN children. Prevent routing-selection races and partial admission, include all three participants in reports, and restore acceptance everywhere on any child failure while combining errors.

Cancellation or timeout must restore admission without cancelling admitted work or restarting background activity. Keep inbound protocol service and autonomous refresh behavior unchanged until Close. Close must finalize concurrent drains without deadlock or panic while preserving shutdown, datastore, disabled-store, construction-cleanup, and error-combination behavior.
